name: motion-ui
description: Comprehensive animated component library for React and Next.js built with Motion and Tailwind CSS.

categories.name: Motion Components
categories.description: Interactive, animated primitives including buttons, inputs, tabs, modals, bottom sheets, sliders, accordions, and loaders.

categories.name: AI Agent Interfaces
categories.description: Specialized UI surfaces for conversational agents: message bubbles, scrollers, prompt inputs, approval cards, code blocks, diffs, and activity streams.

categories.name: Blocks & Widgets
categories.description: Complex composable animated UI widgets: dynamic island, command palette, multi-chain swap, prediction market, availability scheduler, and folder views.

tilt-card.name: Tilt Card
tilt-card.description: 3D perspective tilt on hover with cursor-tracked glare.

button.name: Button
button.description: Spring-pressed Button plus StatefulButton, MagneticButton, and MetallicButton variants.

tabs.name: Tabs
tabs.description: Pill, segment or underline tabs with a spring layoutId indicator.

marquee.name: Marquee
marquee.description: Infinite horizontal or vertical scroll with pause-on-hover.

adaptive-stepper.name: Adaptive Stepper
adaptive-stepper.description: Composable numeric stepper whose fixed footprint adapts at its minimum and maximum while the value rolls between steps.

expandable-control.name: Expandable Control
expandable-control.description: Click-to-expand button and chip controls that reveal a label or trailing action through spring layout continuity.

input.name: Input
input.description: Text input with label, left/right icons, optional stable error row, error shake and success check draw.

select.name: Select
select.description: Composable select primitives whose panel bouncily unfolds out of the trigger and separates, plus a Morph variant where the trigger grows into the panel via shared layout.

switch.name: Switch
switch.description: Toggle with a spring-driven thumb and press feedback.

expanding-arrow-button.name: Animated CTA Buttons
expanding-arrow-button.description: Expressive call-to-action buttons with expanding, hold, and slide interactions.

combobox.name: Combobox
combobox.description: Searchable combobox with a morphing portal, grouped filtering, keyboard navigation, and controlled or uncontrolled state.

multi-select.name: Multi Select
multi-select.description: Composable multi-select primitives with searchable options, removable animated tokens, and a morphing collision-aware panel.

checkbox.name: Checkbox
checkbox.description: Form choice control with a draw-on checkmark, spring press feedback and indeterminate state support.

radio.name: Radio Group
radio.description: Single-select choice control with a gliding layoutId indicator dot and spring press feedback.

bottom-sheet.name: Bottom Sheet
bottom-sheet.description: Vaul-inspired draggable bottom sheet with snap points, inertia and glass surface.

pull-to-refresh.name: Pull to Refresh
pull-to-refresh.description: Native-feeling pull-to-refresh container with drag resistance, threshold feedback and async refresh handling.

bounce-sidebar.name: Bounce Sidebar
bounce-sidebar.description: A vertical sidebar whose active dot jumps between destinations on a curved, spring-loaded path.

shared-layout-bg.name: Shared Layout Background
shared-layout-bg.description: A pill that glides between hovered items via motion's shared layout, with blur enter/exit.

animated-sidebar.name: Animated Sidebar
animated-sidebar.description: A composable application sidebar with morphing nested navigation that folds into an animated icon rail on desktop and becomes a focus-managed sheet on mobile.

preview-rail.name: Preview Rail
preview-rail.description: Codex app-inspired navigation rail with compact ticks that form a hover pyramid and reveal a floating destination preview.

file-tree.name: File Tree
file-tree.description: Composable file and folder primitives with springing branches, a gliding selection, and complete keyboard navigation.

tooltip.name: Tooltip
tooltip.description: Hover or focus tooltip with blur enter/exit and spring spawn.

dock.name: Dock
dock.description: macOS-style dock with grouped actions and a gliding active pill.

context-menu.name: Animated Context Menu
context-menu.description: Composable context-menu primitives with a pointer-origin clip morph, a gliding active row, checkbox and radio choices, keyboard navigation, typeahead, and long-press support.

morphing-modal.name: Morphing Modal
morphing-modal.description: Family-app-style modal. A single panel that morphs its height as you navigate between inner views, with blur cross-fade on content.

popover.name: Popover
popover.description: Gooey popover whose panel oozes out of the trigger through an SVG goo filter — a liquid neck that stretches and pinches — with crisp content fading in on top, plus a Morph variant that clip-morphs open from the trigger corner. Click or hover trigger, controlled or uncontrolled.

center-morph-modal.name: Center Morph Modal
center-morph-modal.description: A composable modal whose full-size surface unfolds from its exact center toward every edge, then folds back the same way with an inset close control.

text-animation.name: Text Animation
text-animation.description: Animated text primitives for spring reveals, chromatic sweeps, shimmer loading states, letter-cascade swaps and character scrambles.

number.name: Number Animation
number.description: Animated number primitives for count-up values, rolling tickers, and fixed-slot digit swaps.

animated-badge.name: Animated Badge
animated-badge.description: Status badge with animated state icons, pulse feedback and compact size variants.

action-swap.name: Action Swap
action-swap.description: CTA button and slot primitives for swapping text and icons with blur motion.

bouncy-accordion.name: Bouncy Accordion
bouncy-accordion.description: Single-open accordion with weighted spring layout, icon rows and reduced-motion-safe content reveals.

animated-toast-stack.name: Animated Toast Stack
animated-toast-stack.description: Stacked toasts with status morphs, swipe dismissal, actions and layout-aware motion.

theme-toggle.name: Theme Toggle
theme-toggle.description: Theme toggle button that repaints the whole page through the View Transition API — a rectangle or circle clip-path reveal, or slats that open across the screen like a shutter.

drawer.name: Drawer
drawer.description: Side panel that slides in from the left or right with a spring, backdrop blur, body scroll lock and esc-to-close.

message-bubble.name: Message Bubble
message-bubble.description: A focused conversational surface with visual tones, independent alignment, grouped messages, expandable content, and interactive link or button support.

range-slider.name: Range Slider
range-slider.description: Slider with tick dots and a vertical-bar thumb that bounces as it lands on each step. Drag or keyboard, reduced-motion safe.

scroll-animation.name: Scroll Animation
scroll-animation.description: Scroll-driven motion: a Lenis smooth-scroll provider and a reading-progress indicator that reads from it.

shader-background.name: Shader Background
shader-background.description: Canvas shader backgrounds (mesh gradient, grain, warp, waves, voronoi, dot orbit and more) with a single typed variant prop. Reduced-motion freezes animated variants.

wheel-picker.name: Wheel Picker
wheel-picker.description: iOS-style picker wheel: a 3D drum on native momentum scroll that snaps to the nearest notch, with wheel, drag and keyboard control. Composes side by side for date and time pickers, reduced-motion safe.

table.name: Table
table.description: Virtualized data table that stays smooth at 10k+ rows, with sortable headers, row selection, column resize and reorder, and a sticky header. Minimal, reduced-motion-safe motion.

cylinder-carousel.name: Cylinder Carousel
cylinder-carousel.description: A carousel whose items line the inside of a cylinder, receding into the center and growing toward the edges. Drag, scroll or arrow-key to roll it, with a springy glide and snap. Reduced-motion drops the glide.

loader.name: Loader
loader.description: Loading indicator with seventeen variants: spinner, dots, bars, dot-matrix, dither, morph, comet, scramble, metaballs, newton, helix, percent, and five terminal-style ascii spinners. Scales from one size prop, uses currentColor, and reduced-motion swaps every transform for a calm opacity pulse.

message.name: Message
message.description: Composable conversation primitives for message rows, grouped bubbles, avatars, metadata, live markers, and a mount-only trailing-edge pop-up for newly sent rows.

todo-list.name: Todo List
todo-list.description: A collapsible agent task plan with morphing status marks, a completion count, compact metadata, and smooth list updates.

prompt-input.name: Prompt Input
prompt-input.description: An auto-growing agent composer with prompt actions, model selection, keyboard submission, and animated send and stop states.

message-scroller.name: Message Scroller
message-scroller.description: A reader-aware conversation viewport that follows streamed output at the live edge and releases control when the reader moves away.

code-block.name: Code Block
code-block.description: A syntax-highlighted code surface with stable streaming updates, line numbers, focused lines, smooth following, and copy feedback.

approval-card.name: Approval Card
approval-card.description: A human-in-the-loop decision surface for approvals, single or multiple-choice questions, custom responses, and multi-step review flows.

file-diff.name: File Diff
file-diff.description: A syntax-highlighted file change disclosure with progressive rows, line numbers, live change counts, smooth following, and completion collapse.

streaming-response.name: Streaming Response
streaming-response.description: A stable response surface with completion actions, rendered content, and an expandable source summary.

image-generation.name: Image Generation
image-generation.description: A stable generated-image surface that moves from queued work through progressive refinement to a completed result without layout shift.

agent-activity.name: Agent Activity
agent-activity.description: One adaptive activity stream for reasoning, searches, tool calls, structured execution traces, or a chronological mix.

loading-states.name: Agent Loading States
loading-states.description: Three thoughtful loading states for AI interfaces: shimmering status text, live agent progress, and cycling reasoning phrases.

tool-approval.name: Tool Approval
tool-approval.description: A human-in-the-loop permission card for reviewing tool details, allowing once, remembering access, or denying execution.

citations.name: Citations
citations.description: Inline citation markers paired with a collapsible, progressively rendered reference collection for grounded agent responses.

tool-result.name: Tool Result
tool-result.description: A lightweight execution disclosure for syntax-highlighted terminal output and request responses that collapses into a compact completed state.

ai-sidebar.name: AI Sidebar
ai-sidebar.description: A collapsible AI workspace sidebar for folders, projects, files, and bookmarks with keyboard navigation, optimistic moves, inline rename, and overflow-aware labels.

infinite-masonry.name: Infinite Masonry
infinite-masonry.description: Responsive virtualized masonry that measures variable-height cards and loads more data as the user nears the end.

chat-app.name: Chat App
chat-app.description: A complete agent conversation workspace composing navigation, messages, streaming, planning, approvals, tools, code, diffs, generated media, sources, and prompt input.

notification-stack.name: Notification Stack
notification-stack.description: Compact notification cards that spring from a stacked summary into a readable list on hover, focus or tap.

project-folder.name: Project Folder
project-folder.description: An interactive project folder that opens its file fan on hover or focus, expands into a focus-managed overlay, then retraces the complete path when closed.

availability-scheduler.name: Availability Scheduler
availability-scheduler.description: Weekly availability editor where each day springs between available and unavailable, time ranges add and remove with blur-slide motion, times pick from a scrollable dropdown, and a copy menu clones hours to other days.

card-folder.name: Card Folder
card-folder.description: A landscape card tucked into a stitched purse pocket that lifts forward as the purse compresses into its bottom seam, with controlled open and card-detail visibility plus a separate overflow action.

knockout-bracket.name: Fixtures
knockout-bracket.description: Animated tournament fixtures in two styles: a knockout bracket that pages through rounds, and a wheel that wraps the same tree around the champion. Both read the same array of rounds, so one dataset draws either.

swap.name: Multi-chain Swap
swap.description: Cross-chain swap widget with chain + token selectors, morphing views, animated flip and quote.

command-palette.name: Command Palette
command-palette.description: ⌘K palette with fuzzy filter, spring-animated active row and glass surface.

expandable-action-bar.name: Expandable Action Bar
expandable-action-bar.description: Compact icon actions that expand into labeled controls on hover or focus with shared layout motion.

dynamic-island.name: Dynamic Island
dynamic-island.description: iOS-style island pill that morphs between live activity views with bouncy shell resize and blur crossfades.

morphing-search.name: Morphing Search
morphing-search.description: Search field or compact icon that morphs into a glass results surface, whether opened by click or keyboard shortcut.

overflow-actions.name: Overflow Actions
overflow-actions.description: Connected pill rail for primary actions that springs open to reveal extra controls.

expandable-tabs.name: Expandable Tabs
expandable-tabs.description: Icon tab bar where the active tab expands to a labelled pill, with a panel above that morphs height and slides content direction-aware on switch.

swipeable-list.name: Swipeable List
swipeable-list.description: Mobile-style list rows that swipe left or right to reveal contextual action buttons.

morphing-tabs.name: Morphing Tabs
morphing-tabs.description: Reorderable tabs whose selected item grows into a white content surface, with the active shape gliding as tabs move and a shared morph between rooms.

file-upload.name: File Upload
file-upload.description: Two file upload patterns: an attachment workspace for mixed files, links, audio and media, plus a progress queue with retry and removal.

prediction-market.name: Prediction Market
prediction-market.description: Prediction market trade ticket with buy/sell modes, outcome prices, rolling amount entry, quick add chips and trade states.

wallet-card.name: Wallet Card
wallet-card.description: Wallet overview card with an account switcher and search that morph open from their triggers, a cascading balance with a live change pill and privacy toggle, copy-address, and Send / Deposit / Swap / Buy actions.

otp-input.name: OTP Input
otp-input.description: One-time-code input with a gliding focus ring, digits that roll in per slot, error shake and a success check draw.

bloom-menu.name: Bloom Menu
bloom-menu.description: A button that morphs open into a menu and blooms iris-out from the center, the grid revealing in every direction with radially staggered items.

signup-form.name: Sign Up Form
signup-form.description: Composed sign-up form that flags a field only once it is left, then clears the moment it is fixed, with a length-weighted strength meter, password reveal and an animated submit lifecycle.

feedback-widget.name: Feedback Widget
feedback-widget.description: Corner trigger that morphs open into a feedback popup with message entry and animated sending, success and retry states.

not-found.name: 404 / Not Found
not-found.description: Animated 404 pages in five styles: glitch scramble, magnetic digits, cursor spotlight, a fanning card stack and a typed terminal.

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.description: Interactive chronological milestone and audit tracker with animated progress lines, status badges, and expandable step disclosures.

kanban.name: Kanban Board
kanban.description: Interactive drag-and-drop task workflow board with spring layoutId reordering, column drop zones, WIP counters, and priority tags.

filter-builder.name: Filter Builder
filter-builder.description: Faceted stepped query filter builder with dynamic attribute selectors, operator dropdowns, AND/OR logic toggles, and animated chip tags.

cascader.name: Cascader
cascader.description: Multi-level cascading drill-down selector with sliding column transitions, breadcrumb trails, instant global search, and keyboard navigation.

rating.name: Rating
rating.description: Interactive star rating component with half-star fractional hover detection, spring bounce micro-interactions on click, and keyboard accessibility.

avatar-group.name: Avatar Group
avatar-group.description: Interactive stacked avatar pile where hovering an avatar springs it forward while adjacent neighbors fan out with distance falloff.

success-check.name: Success Check
success-check.description: Celebration confirmation micro-interaction featuring an expanding circle halo, spring pop-in, SVG path draw checkmark, and haptic feedback.

hover-card.name: Hover Card
hover-card.description: Rich contextual hover card popover with open/close delay buffering, spring entrance, and collision avoidance.

kbd.name: Keyboard Keycap
kbd.description: Hardware-styled keyboard shortcut cap with OS auto-detection (macOS ⌘ vs Windows Ctrl), key combination joins, and tactile spring press feedback.

password-input.name: Password Input
password-input.description: Smart password field with show/hide toggle, animated multi-segment strength meter, and live criteria validation checklist.

spotlight-card.name: Spotlight Card
spotlight-card.description: Interactive craft card with mouse-tracking radial spotlight glow, rotating border beam highlight, and subtle depth elevation.

glow-button.name: Glow Button
glow-button.description: Premium CTA button featuring an iridescent glowing perimeter gradient, magnetic pointer attraction, and tactile spring feedback.

action-sheet.name: Action Sheet
action-sheet.description: Universal mobile action sheet menu with drag gesture dismissal, rubber-band resistance, haptic feedback, and desktop center modal fallback.
